pick.name: Substack (free newsletter)
pick.what: Newsletter + web archive + Notes social feed + recommendations network
pick.why: Free for free newsletters and has a built-in discovery network (recommendations, Notes), which matters most when growing from zero; CSV email export exists
pick.free_limits: Free while unpaid; paid subs: 10% + Stripe fees (Substack currently waives its 10% for India-based creators with Stripe connected, temporary; Stripe India is invite-only for new accounts); custom domain $50 one-time

alts.name: Kit (Newsletter free plan)
alts.why: Best when you want your own sending domain, forms and later digital-product sales: free up to 10,000 subscribers but only 1 automation and Kit branding
alts.free_limits: Free up to 10,000 subs; 1 automation; Kit branding; Creator ~$33-39/mo

alts.name: Buttondown
alts.why: Most developer-friendly (Markdown, API, custom-domain sending) but free only to 100 subscribers
alts.free_limits: Free to 100 subscribers incl. custom-domain sending; $9/$29/$79 add-on tiers

candidates.name: Kit Free
candidates.verdict: 10k subs free, own domain; no discovery

candidates.name: beehiiv Launch
candidates.verdict: Free to 2,500 subs, no monetization, branding stays; custom domain conflicting on page

candidates.name: listmonk
candidates.verdict: Self-host OSS + SES; too much ops for a personal newsletter

decision: Growing a personal audience from zero is the hard part, and Substack is the only free option with a built-in recommendation network. Move to Kit Free (10,000 subs) when you want your own sending domain, lead magnets or to sell products; both allow email export, so lock-in is low.
note: Consolidated: two audiences, two tools. Substack for your personal founder audience; Kit (Sales track) for a product's leads and users. Start with Substack only.
details: Paid Substack subscriptions need Stripe payouts; Stripe India is invite-only. Keep it free.

verify.note: 10% + Stripe is the standard fee, but Substack help reportedly waives the 10% for India/Brazil creators with Stripe connected (temporary); Stripe India invite-only for new accounts may block payouts. $50 custom domain confirmed via secondary sources only; source_url is a pages.dev blog and Substack help returned 403.
